description: This file contains unit tests using Google Test and Google Mock frameworks for cryptographic and system functions related to OpenSSL, including mocking external dependencies for testing file hash calculations, signature preparations, and system commands within the RDM (Resource Description Manager) agent context.

classes.name: MockRdmRbus
classes.description: Mock class for RDM Rbus interface functions, using Google Mock to simulate initialization and uninitialization functions.

classes.name: MockRdmOpenssl
classes.description: Mock class for static cryptographic operations such as ASCII hex conversion and file hash computation.

methods.name: rdmRbusInit
methods.description: Initializes RDM Rbus handle, returns 0 on success, -1 on failure, optionally uses a mock implementation.

methods.name: rdmRbusUnInit
methods.description: Uninitializes RDM Rbus handle, using a mock method if configured.

methods.name: asciihex_to_bin
methods.description: Converts ASCII hex string to binary buffer, mocked in tests.

methods.name: bin_to_asciihex
methods.description: Converts binary buffer to ASCII hex string, mocked in tests.

methods.name: rdm_openssl_file_hash_sha256
methods.description: Calculates SHA256 hash of a file, with a mock implementation for testing.

methods.name: rdm_openssl_file_hash_sha256_pkg_components
methods.description: Calculates SHA256 hash for proprietary package components, with mock support.

methods.name: prepare_sig_file
methods.description: Prepares signature file, mockable for testing.

methods.name: prepare_app_manifest
methods.description: Prepares application manifest, mockable for testing.

calls: extern "C" { rdmRbusInit, rdmRbusUnInit, rdmRbusInit, rdmRbusUnInit, v_secure_system, asciihex_to_bin, bin_to_asciihex, rdm_openssl_file_hash_sha256, rdm_openssl_file_hash_sha256_pkg_components, prepare_sig_file, prepare_app_manifest }
